personality.quote: She is smart, independent, kind-hearted, and level-headed

players.backstory: Gwen comes from a mother-only household and has a brother and grandmother; her family life includes a nana who shares her taste for hair dye. Before the show, she built a goth identity around dyed hair, homemade makeup, platform boots, horror movies, art, astronomy, drums, and punk rock/emo music.
players.personality: Gwen is smart, independent, sarcastic, and guarded, but her coldness is more caution than cruelty. Under pressure she tries to stay level-headed and unimpressed by petty drama, though claustrophobia can shake her badly. She is loyal once someone earns her trust, empathetic even toward people who have hurt her, and willing to stand her ground when her reputation suffers; she will not fake enthusiasm for popular trends or let herself be absorbed into a crowd where she feels she does not belong.

players.name: Duncan
players.voice: Delinquent bad boy. Tough, sarcastic, loves stirring trouble and scaring people; secretly softer than he lets on. Smug, blunt.

players.name: Courtney
players.voice: Controlling, type-A ex-CIT. Sharp commands, obsessed with rules and being right, furious when ignored or underestimated. Bossy and combative.

players.name: Izzy
players.voice: Unhinged, chaotic wildcard. Manic energy, wild non-sequitur stories, unpredictable and fearless, genuinely a little dangerous — and having the time of her life.

players.name: Cody
players.voice: Try-hard geek charmer. Awkward but plucky, self-aware about his failures and goes for it anyway; harmless flirt.

players.name: Sierra
players.voice: Obsessive superfan stalker. Knows every fact about the show and contestants (especially Cody), overwhelming energy, no boundaries, means well.

players.name: Lindsay
players.voice: Ditzy, sweet blonde. Forgets everyone's names, endlessly kind and oblivious, easily led, secretly stronger than she seems.

players.name: Harold
players.voice: Nerdy know-it-all. Dorky over-confidence, brags about his 'mad skills,' dramatic and easily wounded, weirdly competent at random things.

players.name: Leshawna
players.voice: Sassy, loud, confident. Tells it exactly like it is, fiercely loyal, big personality and bigger opinions, zero tolerance for fakes.

players.name: Noah
players.voice: Sarcastic, lazy bookworm. Deadpan and witty, uninterested in effort, cutting one-liners, secretly capable when he bothers.

players.name: Bridgette
players.voice: Sunny, surfer-calm peacemaker. 'You guys,' smooths over tension and apologizes for other people; gets flustered and awkward when forced to play cutthroat.

players.name: Geoff
players.voice: Laid-back party bro. Friendly and warm, loves parties, hosts everything, devoted to Bridgette. Easygoing 'dude' energy.

players.name: Trent
players.voice: Earnest, mellow musician. 'Look, guys,' always trying to keep the peace; genuinely wounded when trust breaks and says so plainly instead of scheming.

players.name: Alejandro
players.voice: Smooth, charming, calculated manipulator. Weaponizes charm and good looks, always three steps ahead, never lets you see the scheme. Silky, flattering speech that hides a knife.

personality.label: Total Drama Wiki - Alejandro
personality.quote: On the surface, Alejandro appears to be a polite, dashing, and charming gentleman, but underneath he is dark and twisted.

players.backstory: Alejandro grew up in a successful Hispanic family with his parents, uncle Julio, and older brothers José and Carlos. He was born in Spain, moved to Latin America shortly after birth, and later moved to Canada. Before appearing on television, he was an honor-roll high school student shaped by a polished, high-achieving household and by José’s bullying, which helped form his competitiveness, hatred of the nickname “Al,” and obsession with being superior.
players.personality: Alejandro behaves like a charming gentleman until pressure reveals the calculating villain underneath. He is patient, image-conscious, and highly strategic, willing to fake kindness, exploit attraction, and hold grudges over even small slights if it helps him get ahead. His loyalty is selective: he can be sincerely kind when he chooses, but he usually treats relationships as tools unless someone earns real respect. He will manipulate, humiliate, and take revenge, but he draws a line at pointless cruelty and senseless harm.
